title: Growth Items
html:
Growth Items are rainbow pieces with a +% Character Size bonus. That is a player name for the SizeM enhancement (see jewelry mythic prefix Up-Sized on Mythic Suffixes). The client has no separate Growth item type.

Size does not help in combat. The old wiki’s listed maximum is 56%: two rings at 13% and one amulet at 26%.
